## ReModel aims

Building a simulation model from scratch is a time-consuming and resource-intensive process. ReModel aims to make it easier for healthcare analysts to read, run, and reuse existing open simulation models. We recognise that within healthcare there is a potential to reuse exisitng models because many of the problems faced by healthcare systems are similar as are many of the pathways experienced by patients. ReModel is a project that aims to make it easier to read, run, and reuse open simulation models.

Our goal is to empower people within the NHS to:

- run open source simulation models on their own machines
- critique/assess/evaluate simulation models with their pros and cons
- repurpose existing simulation models for their own use cases
